The predecessor is the gate: the same token is at the floor after a determiner, possessive, preposition, conjunction, auxiliary or punctuation, or after a free modifier that could take any head ('the House' 0.27, 'the system' 0.00, 'a year' 0.00, 'my office' 0.18, 'the upper House' 0.00, 'metric system' 0.24), except for a handful of tokens with near-universal affinity (' today', ' colleagues', ' day', ' year', ' month', ' week', ' morning', ' term') which fire after most predecessors of any class, including a selecting determiner, possessive or conjunction ('his colleagues' 1.27, 'said today' 2.17, 'every morning' 1.30).
